purpose: One small bounded pilot to test domain-matched public human-written data.

pilotTranche.selection: Train-support and taxonomy driven; direct weak-label rows first; enISEAR validation>=3 and one worker per selected row; no Dev or holdout content

training.evaluation: single legal 149-row Dev evaluation after training; unchanged precision guard and selector; no sweep

decision: PROMOTE only if Macro-F1 exceeds 0.345179 and existing precision guard remains satisfied; otherwise REJECT and stop.
